newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 26.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 26.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices remained steady, tracking cargo levels, traders said. Majors said demand was firm with 380-cst supplies seen traded at $124-$124.50 per tonne. Cst 180 supplies were indicated at $118-$119, traders said. They said in the near term, cst 380-and cst 180 spread may widen as more 380-cst supplies from Kuwait arrive in the Far East. MDO were stable at $210 and gas oil at $222.
